package domain

import "testing"

func TestOnboardingPathAuthoringOmitsAbsentStudentValues(t *testing.T) {
	graph := GoalGraph{Goal: LearningGoal{Code: "programming.foundation", Version: "v1", GraphVersion: "graph", Title: "Foundation"}, Targets: []LearningTarget{{Ref: TargetRef{Type: "concept", Key: "a", Version: "v1"}, Title: "A", ModuleCode: "m", ModuleTitle: "M", SectionCode: "s", SectionTitle: "S", LessonCode: "l", LessonTitle: "L"}}}
	policy := PolicyBundle{PlannerVersion: "p", PedagogyProfile: "p", PresentationStyle: "s", GenerationPolicy: "g", PedagogyStrategies: []PedagogyStrategyVersion{{Code: "explicit_instruction", Version: 1, Config: []byte(`{}`)}}}
	snapshot := StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{Schema: StudentReadinessSnapshotSchema, StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StateRef: StudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: StudentReadinessStateDraft, Version: 1}, Profile: StudentReadinessProfile{KnownStacks: StudentReadinessStackValues{State: StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered}, DesiredStacks: StudentReadinessStackValues{State: StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered}, ContentLanguage: &StudentReadinessLanguage{Code: "ru", Provenance: "explicit_ui", Source: "preferred_language"}, PreferredLanguage: &StudentReadinessLanguage{Code: "ru", Provenance: "explicit_ui"}}}
	in, err := NewOnboardingPathAuthoringInput(graph, policy, snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(in.KnownStacks) != 0 || len(in.DesiredStacks) != 0 || in.ContentLanguage != "ru" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected invented profile %#v", in)
	}
	context := in.CourseContext()
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"direction_code", "self_assessed_experience", "known_stacks", "desired_stacks"} {
		if _, exists := context[forbidden]; exists {
			t.Fatalf("context emitted absent %s: %#v", forbidden, context)
		}
	}
}
